title: Research Fellowships in Mathematics, Astronomy and Physics (from 1 October 2027)
field: Applied mathematics, pure mathematics, astronomy, physics
about: Trinity Hall, Cambridge, invites applications for Research Fellowships starting 1 October 2027 in applied mathematics, pure mathematics, astronomy and physics. The term usually runs three years with little teaching. Applications close Monday 9 November, 5pm.
requirements: Open in four areas: applied mathematics, pure mathematics, astronomy and physics
Joint scheme with other Cambridge colleges; the college typically funds two posts a year

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Research Fellowships" for "Early-career researchers" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Open in four areas: applied mathematics, pure mathematics, astronomy and physics" (research posts) → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
Note: the course supports research workflows, not the mathematics or physics subject matter itself.
